about: Official product pictures for the Devices room, by model and variant. Exo ships only these links: it fetches each picture when a device first shows, from the maker's own image server (where a maker publishes nothing large or clean, an authorized store's copy of its official shot; for mice, OpenMouse's render server), cuts its background away, fits it to one frame and keeps it on this PC (Services/DeviceImages.cs). Each is the maker's hero shot, straight on or angled, sharp at the room's size, on transparency, white or a flat light studio color: a model whose only pictures are on a dark or scene background, or whose white or clear shell can't be told from its white background, is left out and Exo draws it. The first entry of a model is its default; variant is a controller's color or a keyboard's layout; ids are devices.list's model ids and, for a mouse, the OpenMouse render Exo Mouse picked for it; aliases are other names it reports or is sold under; cut says what else comes away with the background (shadow: the studio's soft shadow or floor reflection; holes: background seen through a closed loop, a coiled cable or a headband).
